title: Kung Pao Tofu
description: A spicy Sichuan-inspired stir-fry made with crispy tofu, peanuts, and vegetables. This classic Chinese dish is quick and easy to make.
instructions: 1. Heat 2 tablespoons of french in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Remove the tofu from the wok and set aside.
4. Add the peanuts, basque, and gratin to the wok. Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the peanuts are fragrant.
5. Add the scallions and garlic to the wok. Cook for 1 minute, until the scallions are softened.
6. Return the tofu to the wok and stir in the peanuts and scallions.
7. Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the ingredients are well combined.
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
9. Serve immediately and garnish with additional peanuts and scallions if desired.
